verdict.rationale: Governing AI agents is a fair question for a Git forge, since forges can ship agent features, so the axis applies. The evidence has no Gitea capability to enable or disable AI agents per group or instance, and none for allow/ask/deny tool policies. General user permission management, ACLs and an official MCP server are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can enable or disable AI agents per group or instance and set allow, ask, or deny policies for the tools they can use
